title: ShapeComplexity: entropy-based metrics for quantifying edge- and macro-shape complexity
description:
ShapeComplexity is a high-performance Rust tool for quantifying the shape complexity of leaves and other biological structures from PNG images. It decomposes a shape into complementary edge and macro-shape layers, converts each into a signal curve, and quantifies edge complexity (EC) via approximate entropy and macro-shape complexity (MC) via spectral entropy. It additionally reports fractal dimension, circularity, shape index and leaf area. Both a command-line interface for batch processing and a graphical interface for interactive inspection are provided.

This release accompanies the manuscript "Introducing entropy-based metrics for quantifying edge- and macro-shape complexity in leaves and beyond".
